name: New York Harbor
grid_rotation_note: same anchor and rotation as times_square: one shared local frame, no offsets
exclude_note: the Times Square district's own area (its buildings and terrain come from times_square)
local_rect_note: the harbour IS this rectangle in the shared local frame (axis-aligned with Times Square's grid). It surrounds Times Square's rectangle (excluded) on the west, east and north, so the map and scenery have no gaps around Midtown: from Liberty Island up to ~77th St / Central Park
